in_sanskrit.name: अमित्रि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is friendly with the divine, a friend of Indra

in_hindi.name: अमित्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mitra ka mitra, friend of a friend

in_marathi.name: Amitri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amitri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'amita' meaning boundless and 'ri' meaning friend.

in_bengali.name: Amitri
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Boundless Friend
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amitri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'amita' meaning boundless and 'ri' meaning friend.
